args.summary: checkout-api deployed v2.3.1 to production and subsequently failed health checks (healthy=false, error_rate 18%). Per runbook, rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release. First rollback attempt hit an orchestrator error and halted after us-east only; a retry completed the rollout. All production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0, service is healthy, error rate back to 0.2%. Recommend investigating v2.3.1 failure before re-release.
args.title: checkout-api rollback from unhealthy v2.3.1 to v2.3.0

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
All done. Summary:

**Rollback**
- Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production; v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.
- First rollback attempt failed partway (orchestrator error) leaving us-east on v2.3.0 but us-west/eu-west still on broken v2.3.1.
- Retried the rollback successfully: all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on v2.3.0.
- Verified: service is healthy across all regions, error rate back down to 0.2% (from 18%).

**Incident**
- Opened **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback (including the partial failure and retry), current healthy status, and a recommendation to investigate v2.3.1 before re-releasing. A creation timeout occurred, but the incident was confirmed created via `list_incidents`, so no duplicate was opened.
